ko_items: 조리 없이 먹는 비상식량 3일~2주분과 수동 캔따개
가족 연락 방법과 집결 장소 미리 정하기
en_items: Water: about 4 L (1 gallon) per person per day, at least 3 days (2 weeks if possible)
No-cook food for 3 days to 2 weeks, manual can opener
Two weeks of prescription and basic medicines, first-aid supplies
Flashlight or lantern, spare batteries
Battery or hand-crank radio
Power bank and charging cables
Some cash in case card payments stop
Copies of ID, insurance and bank documents in a waterproof bag
Masks, hygiene items, blankets and warm clothes, whistle
A family contact plan and meeting point

ko_items: 가장 가까운 민방위 대피소 위치 확인 (안전디딤돌 앱·국민재난안전포털)
화생방 대비: 방독면 또는 젖은 수건, 비닐·알루미늄 테이프로 창틀 밀폐
해외 체류 시 외교부 해외안전여행 동행 서비스 등록, 여권 유효기간 확인
사업: 분쟁 위험국 거래는 K-SURE 단기수출보험 검토, 현지 인력 철수 계획, 대체 공급처 확보
en_items: Know your nearest public shelter
Learn the alert types: alert, air raid, CBRN
CBRN basics: gas mask or wet towel, plastic sheeting and tape to seal windows
Keep your fuel tank at least half full
Abroad: register with your embassy, check passport validity
Business: insure receivables in conflict-risk markets, plan staff evacuation, line up alternative suppliers

ko_items: 2주~3개월분 순환 비축: 쌀·곡물, 통조림, 건조식품, 식용유, 소금·설탕
먼저 산 것부터 먹고 채우기 (유통기한 순환)
정수 필터 또는 정수 정제 준비
공황 구매는 하지 않기 — 평소에 조금씩 늘리기
사업: FAO 식량가격지수·GIEWS 경보 확인, 원재료 공급처 다변화
en_items: Rotating 2-week to 3-month stock: rice and grains, canned food, dried food, cooking oil, salt and sugar
Eat the oldest first and refill (rotate by expiry)
Water filter or purification tablets
No panic buying — build up gradually in normal times
Business: watch the FAO Food Price Index and GIEWS alerts, diversify ingredient suppliers

ko_items: 사업: 핵심 인력 대체 근무표, 원격 업무 BCP
en_items: Respirator masks, hand sanitiser, thermometer
One to three months of regular medicines
Check vaccinations
Test remote work and video meetings in advance
Follow health-ministry and WHO outbreak notices
Business: backup rota for key staff, remote-work continuity plan

ko_items: 예금은 금융기관별 예금자보호 한도 안에서 나눠 두기
사업: 정부 경기부양·인프라·고용 사업을 레이더로 추적 (위기 때 정부 발주가 늘어남)
이 항목은 일반 정보이며 투자 조언이 아닙니다
en_items: Emergency fund for 3 to 6 months of living costs
Pay down high-interest debt first
Spread deposits within each bank's deposit-insurance limit
Hold some cash
Diversify income and customers, cut fixed costs
Business: track stimulus, infrastructure and jobs programmes on the radar — public spending rises in downturns
General information, not investment advice

ko_items: 휴대용 버너와 연료 (실내 사용 시 환기)
냉장고·냉동고 문 열지 않기 (냉장 약 4시간 유지)
중요한 연락처는 종이에, 중요한 파일은 오프라인 백업
사업: UPS·발전기, 오프라인 백업, 사이버보안 점검
en_items: Flashlights, lanterns, power banks, solar charger
Battery radio
Camping stove and fuel (ventilate indoors)
Cash in case cards and mobile payments stop
Keep the fridge and freezer closed (fridge stays cold about 4 hours)
Avoid lifts during outages
Key contacts on paper, important files backed up offline
Business: UPS or generator, offline backups, cyber-security check

ko_items: 지진: 흔들리면 탁자 아래로, 멈추면 계단으로 넓은 곳으로
해일: 해안에서 경보가 나오거나 바닷물이 갑자기 빠지면 즉시 높은 곳으로
태풍·호우: 창문 고정, 하천·해안 접근 금지
가구 고정, 비상 대피 경로 확인
en_items: Turn on emergency alerts on your phone
Earthquake: drop under a table; when it stops, take the stairs to open ground
Tsunami: if warned on the coast, or the sea suddenly recedes, go to high ground at once
Storms and floods: secure windows, stay away from rivers and coasts
Volcanic ash: mask and goggles, stay indoors
Secure furniture, know your evacuation route

sig_ko: 레이더 위험 등급 '위험' 국가 수 증가
sig_en: More countries at 'high' risk on the radar
Neighbours raising defence budgets or conscription
War-risk insurance spikes on shipping lanes (Red Sea, Hormuz, Malacca)
move_ko: 방산 협력국(폴란드·중동·동남아) 정부 조달에 부품·소재·정비 공급사로 진입
재건 수요 대비: 전력·통신·의료·모듈러 주택 컨소시엄 사전 구성 (우크라이나형 재건 기금, EDCF)
분쟁 인접국에 생산·공급 대체 거점 제안
move_en: Enter defence-partner procurement (Poland, Middle East, Southeast Asia) as a parts, materials or MRO supplier
Pre-form reconstruction consortia for power, telecoms, health and modular housing
Alternative logistics routes and local warehousing
Offer neighbouring countries backup production and supply bases

sig_en: FAO Food Price Index up three months running
Grain or fertiliser export bans by major exporters
El Niño/La Niña or drought alerts
Sharp currency falls in food-importing countries
move_ko: 스마트팜·저장·콜드체인 장비를 식량안보 정부 사업에 공급
식량 수입국 정부 대상 비축·유통 디지털화 컨설팅
move_en: Supply smart-farm, storage and cold-chain equipment to food-security programmes
Stockpile and distribution digitisation for importing governments
Alternative protein and processed-food exports
Join agricultural ODA projects
prep_en: Consider locking ingredient prices for 6 months
Suppliers in at least two countries

sig_ko: WHO 질병 발생 소식(DON) 급증·국제공중보건위기 선포
sig_en: Surge in WHO outbreak notices or a PHEIC declaration
move_en: Pitch diagnostics, disinfection, telehealth and hospital IT to health ministries
Remote education and e-government programmes
Partner on local production of vaccines and devices

sig_en: Sovereign downgrades or worse K-SURE grades
move_ko: 경기부양 인프라·고용 사업에 컨소시엄 참여 (위기국 정부 발주는 오히려 늘어남)
비용 절감형 AI 자동화·디지털 행정 솔루션
다자개발은행(세계은행·ADB) 재원 사업으로 대금 위험 줄이기
move_en: Join stimulus infrastructure and jobs programmes — public procurement often rises in a downturn
Cost-cutting AI automation and digital-government solutions
Prefer multilateral-bank funded projects to reduce payment risk

sig_en: Grid reserve warnings, heatwaves or cold snaps
move_en: Supply ESS, microgrids and UPS to government, hospitals and data centres
Public-sector cyber-security audits and monitoring
Grid modernisation projects

move_ko: 조기경보·재난관리 시스템을 정부에 제안 (한국 재난문자·통합관제 경험)
move_en: Pitch early-warning and disaster-management systems
Modular housing, water purification and power for recovery
Climate-adaptation ODA and Green Climate Fund projects
